Name: Country Windows for Dynamic Windows
Author: Breelier
Description:
This mod adds a collection of farmhouse and cottage-style windows.
This mod is a content pack and requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35690]Dynamic Windows[/url] to function.

[line]

[size=4][b]🌟 Key Features[/b][/size]

Below you can see how these windows look and interact in-game.

[quote]🛒 [b]Where to find them:[/b] Once installed, all of these country-style windows will be added directly to the [b]Furniture Catalogue[/b].

💡 [b]Please Note:[/b] The amazing interactive mechanics, seasonal wildlife, and weather effects shown below are all core features powered by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35690]Dynamic Windows[/url] framework! To see the full list of what this framework can do, feel free to check out the original mod page.
[i](Also note: Not all windows in this pack are openable; the showcase below demonstrates the openable variants!)[/i][/quote]
[size=3][b]1. Interactive Windows[/b][/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/43639012-1782814632.gif[/img]

[size=3][b]2. Spring Butterflies[/b][/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/43639012-1782814590.gif[/img]

[size=3][b]3. Winter Snow[/b][/size]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/43639012-1782814653.gif[/img]

[line]

[size=4][b]🛠️ How to Install & Configure[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*][b]Prerequisites[/b]: Make sure you have installed both [b]Content Patcher[/b] and [b]Dynamic Windows[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Download[/b]: Download this mod and unzip the file.[/*]
[*][b]Install[/b]: Drop the [i][DW] Country Windows[/i] folder directly into your Stardew Valley [i]Mods[/i] folder.[/*]
[*][b]Configure In-Game[/b]:
[list]
[*] Open the [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] in-game.[/*]
[*]Navigate to [b]Dynamic Windows[/b] -> [b]Background Style[/b].[/*]
[*]Select [b][color=#ffff00]`Breelier.CountryWindows`[/color][/b] from the options.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
